# pluto Provider

Manage Pluto Security policies through Pluto's external API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    pluto = {
      source = "plutosecurity/pluto"
    }
  }
}

provider "pluto" {
  host = "https://api.example.pluto.security" # or PLUTO_HOST
  # api_key is read from PLUTO_API_KEY: a pluto_... key with policy write access
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) A Pluto API key (pluto_...) with policy write access. Defaults to PLUTO_API_KEY.
- `host` (String) Your Pluto API URL, e.g. https://api.example.pluto.security. Defaults to PLUTO_HOST.
